remarks: Welcome to this nicely appointed 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhome style unit, perfectly situated close to it all in Stamford! Upon entering, you'll immediately notice the modern floors, freshly painted living area and main features that make this one desirable. The delightful kitchen offers generous counter space, abundant natural light and sleek stainless-steel appliances that will inspire your culinary creativity. The open and inviting living and dining areas with fireplace benefit from lots of light coming from the large sliding glass doors that lead out to a charming balcony--where it is easy to want to sit and enjoy your morning coffee. A half bath and a few closets complete the main level. Once upstairs, retreat to the spacious primary bedroom with two closets, while the versatile second bedroom can easily double as a home office. Two large full bathrooms and a dedicated washer/dryer laundry closet round out this level. A deeded garage parking space is located close to the elevator for easy access to the unit. All of this is just minutes to the center of vibrant downtown--where countless trendy restaurants and entertainment options await--or relax and enjoy beach access to the local beaches. For your commuting convenience, the property is walking distance to the train for a 50-minute ride into NYC. Don't miss this one!
